criteria.rationale: Separate execution /root/amendment_review inspected recorded-start validity and declared-history limits. Identity is declared, not cryptographic or human-confirmed; cognitive independence is not observable. Cooperative locking excludes arbitrary filesystem edits; materiality remains review judgment.

Amend uses the existing nonblocking lifecycle lock shared by start and close; close repeats the history gate under that lock. Reviewer reran regression controls; primary full race on domain and CLI passed in isolated /var/tmp.

Schema 1 remains R-only and schema 2 requires explicit adoption. Missing journals remain opt-out, existing events stay append-only, and explicit baseline retains current-state meaning. B11 terminal-plan verification remains a separate scope.
Inspected malformed, tampered, wrong-spec and incomplete start refusal plus invalid requested-change zero writes. Append and Sync errors are propagated without truncation or automatic repair.
Registered integration exercises actual domain and CLI amendment/lint/close producers. Existing MCP reads unchanged schemas; no MCP write or catalog contract changed.
Errors name history findings and explicit repair, in-progress lint warns without falsely claiming done enforcement, and seed rationale identifies its start source without backdating.
Intentional stricter close behavior is recorded in accepted ADR and changelog. Existing schema/adoption/legacy opt-in contracts are preserved; no migration or policy adoption is inferred.

Reviewer reran TestAmendmentHistory, TestAmend and ABMContractNodes plus trace and protected-close controls; final registered integration passed. Initial verified-assumption fixture failure was corrected with typed evidence and scope, not by weakening production validation.

D1 addresses the two observed causes: first change omitted earlier start nodes, and done-only lint allowed an invalid transition. Seed from immutable recorded start and shared prospective gate correct them without a second journal or taxonomy.

mappings.rationale: The accepted ADR implements the existing R1-R3 contract through recorded-start seeding and the shared pretransition history gate.

criteria.rationale: Inspected EN/PT manuals, generated scaffold, canonical spec R1-R3, ADR and honest implementation report. Artifact action declarations were corrected after the strict gate caught staging-based classification; current sealed evidence follows that correction.

No automatic repair, retry loop, past approval or backdated event is fabricated. Partial append remains inspectable and actionable. Recorded start source is identified, and existing nonempty journals are never silently reseeded.

R1 seeded old hashes and unchanged nodes, R2 refused before lifecycle writes and rechecked under lock, and R3 emitted nonfatal in-progress warnings. Each has permanent tests and current registered integration evidence.

Only the canonical amendment prerequisite R1-R3 is delivered. B11 semantic terminal verification, release, remote publication and parent gitlink adoption are excluded. Print-site ratchet adjustment records an actual decrease.

Inspected path validation, shared lifecycle lock, invalid-history refusals and absence of automatic authority changes. Primary govulncheck and pinned secret scan passed; reviewer did not claim to execute those scanners.

Smallest sufficient solution reuses start projection, amendment schemas, lifecycle lock and one shared history assessment. Current-text auto-seeding would erase the change; a second journal or general recovery framework is unnecessary. Generic adversarial corpus expansion is explicitly owned as a low-priority follow-up.
